title: CDA AdoptionPlan
description: The phased plan produced by src/adopter/lib/AdoptionPlan.psm1's New-AdoptionPlan, as it appears embedded in an Assessment's own `plan` field (see assessment.schema.json). Nothing described by this document is ever executed automatically -- it is read-only output; execution requires the separate approve -> approved-plan -> apply lifecycle (approved-plan.schema.json, apply-report.schema.json).

id.description: Stable operation id (see docs/artifact-model.md, 'Operation model'), e.g. repo.defaultBranch, ruleset.bypassActors, branch.delete.develop, hygiene.pages.

requiresManualChange.description: true means this is a repository FILE change (a workflow/config edit) -- Apply can never execute it, only report it as pending manual work.

destructive.description: Independent safety property (see docs/safety-model.md, 'Destructive operations registry') -- true means this operation can never be approved via a bulk safe-changes sweep, regardless of its classification.

phase.description: 0=Blockers/prerequisites, 1=Hygiene/safe settings, 2=CI normalization, 3=Branching migration, 4=Release architecture migration, 5=Security hardening, 6=Cleanup legacy configuration, 7=Final verification.
